lessons.title: Six pairs of twins
lessons.intro: Každé slovo tady má dvojče, které znamená skoro totéž. Když umíš obě, zní tvoje angličtina mnohem líp.

ex.s: “That modern painting is huge!” “Wow! It’s really ___.”
ex.why: Huge = enormous, obě znamenají obrovský.

ex.s: “These clothes are nice and colourful.” “You’re right. They’re very ___.”
ex.why: Colourful = bright, barevný a zářivý.
Huge a enormous jsou dvojčata (obrovský). Pretty znamená hezký.

ex.cz: Líbí se mi tahle nástěnná malba, protože je hodně neobvyklá.
ex.a: I like this mural because it’s very unusual.

lessons.title: What is it made of?
lessons.intro: Z čeho je to vyrobené? Anglicky se ptáš What is it made of? a odpovídáš It’s made of wood.

ex.why: Pozor na dvojici wood (dřevo) a wool (vlna). Liší se jen koncem.

ex.s: 🧣 My scarf is made of ___.
My beads are made of ___. They’re shiny and you can see through them.
ex.why: Skrz sklo je vidět. Glass = sklo.

ex.a: The box is made of cardboard.

ex.s: Picasso painted on wood and also on textiles such as ___.
ex.why: Textile je látka. Z materiálů je látka jen cotton (bavlna).

ex.a: The cap is made of cotton.
My shoes are made of leather.
My scarf is made of wool.

lessons.title: Art and artists
lessons.intro: Činnost a člověk, který ji dělá. Většinou přidáš na konec -er, -or nebo -ist.

ex.why: Painting je malování nebo obraz. Painter je člověk, který maluje.

ex.s: Banksy is a famous ___. You can see his paintings on walls around the world.
My sister wants to become a clothes ___.
ex.why: Chce se stát člověkem, takže potřebuješ tvar pro člověka: designer.

ex.a: Banksy is a famous street artist.

ex.s: I bought a new camera because I love ___.
ex.why: Miluješ činnost, ne člověka: photography.

ex.s: My uncle plays the trumpet, saxophone and piano. He’s the best ___ I know.

ex.a: I would like to be an illustrator.
I would like to be an illustrator.

lessons.title: What were you doing?
lessons.intro:
Past continuous říká, co se zrovna dělo v nějakém okamžiku v minulosti. Jako když zastavíš video uprostřed jízdy.

I / he / she / it was + -ing
you / we / they were + -ing
At five o’clock I was paddling on the river.
They weren’t wearing warm clothes.
Were you standing at the front?

ex.s: I ___ watching the artists at work.
ex.why: K „I“ patří was.

ex.s: They ___ painting a huge mural.
ex.why: K „they“ patří were.

ex.s: Some artists were ___ street art near our school.
ex.why: Po was/were vždycky přijde sloveso s -ing.

ex.s: The painter was very busy. He ___ talking.
ex.why: He → was, zápor wasn’t.

ex.s: ___ they painting a huge mural?
ex.why: Otázka: was/were jde na začátek. A k „they“ patří were.

ex.a: They were painting a huge mural.

ex.cz: V pět hodin jsem pádlovala na řece.
ex.a: At five o’clock I was paddling on the river.
We were laughing on the journey home.

ex.s: It was a warm day, so I ___ summer clothes.
Everyone was happy because it ___.

ex.a: At five o’clock I was paddling on the river.

lessons.title: Suddenly…
lessons.intro:
Představ si, že jedeš trať. Jízda trvá dlouho, to je past continuous. Najednou ti spadne čepice, to je krátký okamžik, past simple.

I was reading when my phone rang.
dlouhý děj ← přerušil ho krátký
While I was studying, my friend texted me.
while = zatímco (u dlouhého děje)

opts: I suddenly saw Luna at the art gallery.
I was suddenly seeing Luna at the art gallery.
ex.a: I suddenly saw Luna at the art gallery.
ex.why: Suddenly = najednou. To je krátký okamžik, na ten patří past simple.

opts: It was snowing at the time of the accident.
It snowed at the time of the accident.
ex.a: It was snowing at the time of the accident.
ex.why: Sněžilo dlouho a nehoda se stala uprostřed. Dlouhý děj = past continuous.

ex.s: I was walking to school when I ___ some incredible street art.
ex.why: Uviděla jsi to v jednom okamžiku: past simple.

ex.s: While I ___, my friend texted me.
ex.why: Po while je dlouhý děj: past continuous.

ex.a: While I was studying, my friend texted me.

ex.s: Someone stole the painting while the guard ___.

ex.cz: Pádlovala jsem, když se mi zlomilo pádlo.
ex.a: I was paddling when my paddle broke.

ex.s: We ___ the window while we were playing football.
ex.why: Rozbití okna je krátký okamžik: past simple. Break je nepravidelné sloveso.

ex.s: My phone rang while I ___ TV.

ex.a: I was reading when my phone rang.

lessons.title: The lost painting
lessons.intro: V italském městě Piacenza čistili zahradníci zeď galerie. Najednou ve zdi něco našli… Všechno, co ses naučila, teď použiješ dohromady.

ex.s: Some gardeners at an art gallery ___ cleaning plants from a wall.
Suddenly, they found something in a ___ bag inside the wall.
ex.why: Sáček (bag) bývá z plastu.

ex.s: It was an old ___.
ex.why: Našli věc, obraz. Painter je člověk.

ex.s: Someone ___ this famous painting from the gallery 23 years earlier.
ex.why: Steal → stole = ukradl.

ex.s: The manager was very ___ to see it.
The artist Gustav Klimt was famous for his bright and ___ paintings.
ex.why: Bright a colourful jsou dvojčata.

ex.a: The painting was inside the wall.
That’s incredible! Was the painting OK?
The mural is huge and very colourful.
We were laughing on the journey home.
My scarf is made of wool.
She was painting a forest scene.
Were you standing at the front?
I saw some incredible street art.
The sculptor was working on a huge sculpture.
It was snowing when we arrived.

lines.en: Leo, look at this mural! It’s enormous!
lines.cz: Leo, podívej na tuhle nástěnnou malbu! Je obrovská!

lines.en: Wow, it’s really huge. And it’s very colourful.
lines.cz: Páni, je fakt obrovská. A je hodně barevná.

lines.en: I love the snake. It’s a bit strange, but it’s brilliant.
lines.cz: Miluju toho hada. Je trochu zvláštní, ale je úžasný.

lines.en: Who painted it?
lines.cz: Kdo ji namaloval?

lines.en: A street artist from Glasgow. She was painting it all week.
lines.cz: Pouliční umělkyně z Glasgow. Malovala ji celý týden.

lines.en: Was she using paint or chalk?
lines.cz: Používala barvy, nebo křídu?

lines.en: Paint. Chalk washes away when it rains.
lines.cz: Barvy. Křídu smyje déšť.

lines.en: Cool. I’d like to be a street artist one day.
lines.cz: Super. Jednou bych chtěl být pouliční umělec.

qs.q: What does Mia love in the mural?
Where is the street artist from?
How long was she painting the mural?

lines.en: Hi Mia! I called you at six yesterday, but you didn’t answer.
lines.cz: Ahoj Mio! Volal jsem ti včera v šest, ale nebrala jsi to.

lines.en: Sorry! At six I was paddling on the river.
lines.cz: Promiň! V šest jsem pádlovala na řece.

lines.en: In the rain? It was raining all evening!
lines.cz: V dešti? Celý večer pršelo!

lines.en: Yes. We were training for a race. I was wearing my rain jacket.
lines.cz: Jo. Trénovali jsme na závod. Měla jsem na sobě bundu do deště.

lines.en: And what were you doing at eight? I called again.
lines.cz: A co jsi dělala v osm? Volal jsem znovu.

lines.en: I was making a bracelet. My phone was in my bag.
lines.cz: Dělala jsem náramek. Telefon jsem měla v tašce.

lines.en: A bracelet? What is it made of?
lines.cz: Náramek? Z čeho je?

lines.en: Glass beads and cotton. I can make one for you!
lines.cz: Ze skleněných korálků a bavlny. Můžu udělat jeden i pro tebe!

lines.en: Really? Thanks, that’s brilliant!
lines.cz: Vážně? Díky, to je skvělé!

qs.q: What was Mia doing at six?
What was Mia doing at eight?
What is the bracelet made of?

lines.en: Welcome to our gallery. This painting is very special.
lines.cz: Vítejte v naší galerii. Tenhle obraz je výjimečný.

lines.en: Why? It looks quite unusual.
lines.cz: Proč? Vypadá docela neobvykle.

lines.en: Someone stole it twenty years ago. Last year a gardener found it.
lines.cz: Někdo ho před dvaceti lety ukradl. Loni ho našel zahradník.

lines.en: Really? Where did he find it?
lines.cz: Vážně? Kde ho našel?

lines.en: He was cleaning a wall when he saw a plastic bag inside it.
lines.cz: Čistil zeď, když v ní uviděl plastový sáček.

lines.en: That’s incredible! Was the painting OK?
lines.cz: To je neuvěřitelné! Byl obraz v pořádku?

lines.en: Yes, it was in good condition. We were all very surprised.
lines.cz: Ano, byl v dobrém stavu. Všichni jsme byli moc překvapení.

lines.en: I’d like to be a painter one day. Or maybe an illustrator.
lines.cz: Jednou bych chtěla být malířka. Nebo možná ilustrátorka.

qs.q: When did someone steal the painting?
What would Mia like to be?

writing.title: Můj obraz
writing.task: Describe a picture you painted or drew. What is it? What colours are in it? Is it unusual? What do you like about it?
writing.cz: Popiš obrázek, který jsi namalovala nebo nakreslila. Stačí 3–5 vět.
writing.focus: adjectives from Unit 2 (huge, colourful, unusual, brilliant, pretty, strange) and materials

writing.title: Včera v pět
writing.task: What were you doing yesterday at five o’clock? And at seven? And at nine?
writing.cz: Napiš 3–5 vět, co jsi včera dělala v různé hodiny. Použij was/were + -ing.
writing.placeholder: Yesterday at five o’clock I was…

writing.title: Neobvyklá výstava
writing.task: Imagine you are organizing an unusual art exhibition. What is the title? Where is it? What kind of art is in it? What is unusual about it?
writing.cz: Vymysli neobvyklou výstavu a popiš ji ve 4–6 větách.
writing.focus: art and artists vocabulary, materials, adjectives

writing.title: Proč jsem to nebrala
writing.task: Your friend called you twice yesterday, but you didn’t answer. Write a message and explain what you were doing.
writing.placeholder: Hi! Sorry, when you called I was…
writing.focus: past continuous and past simple (when, while)
